perk.destinedtraits.rampage.desc: Kills with this weapon grant a stacking damage bonus.
perk.destinedtraits.rapid_hit.desc: Critical hits with this weapon grant a stacking bonus to\nattack speed.
perk.destinedtraits.pulse_monitor.desc: This weapon grants knockback resistance as your health\ngets lower.
perk.destinedtraits.subsistence.desc: Kills with this weapon restore durability.
perk.destinedtraits.field_prep.desc: Move faster and gain a bonus to attack reach while sneaking.
perk.destinedtraits.utilitarian.desc: Using an item while holding this weapon restores durability.
perk.destinedtraits.demolitionist.desc: Causing an explosion while holding this weapon restore\ndurability.
perk.destinedtraits.attrition_orbs.desc: Dealing damage with this weapon has a chance to spawn\nexperience orbs.
perk.destinedtraits.loose_change.desc: Damaging an enemy under the effect of a potion grants a\nbonus to attack speed.
perk.destinedtraits.under_pressure.desc: This weapon deals more damage as your health gets lower.
perk.destinedtraits.unrelenting.desc: Rapid kills with this weapon regenerate health.
perk.destinedtraits.adrenaline_junkie.de: Dealing damage with an explosion grants a stacking damage buff.
perk.destinedtraits.withering_touch.desc: Dealing damage with this weapon has a chance to apply\nwither to your target.
perk.destinedtraits.adagio.desc: Kills with this weapon reduce your attack speed in exchange\nfor greater damage.
perk.destinedtraits.wild_woven.desc: Dealing damage, collecting experience, and using items\ngrants a stacking bonus to weapon reach and knockback.
perk.destinedtraits.sifting_echo.desc:
While invisible, hostile mobs detect you from only 7% of their normal range.
Critical hits deal 25% more damage per two Sifting Echo armor pieces.
Dealing damage while invisible breaks invisibility and blocks it until combat timer and progress both reach 0.
Standing up to 4 blocks beyond a hostile mob's effective detection range restores 1 hunger every 10 seconds.
Additional Sifting Echo armor restores hunger faster.
perk.destinedtraits.field_forged.desc: Rapid kills with this weapon restore hunger.
perks.destinedtraits.hydrostatic_pressur: Gain armor toughness as your air depletes.
perks.destinedtraits.in_the_deep.desc: Gain increased weapon reach while you are underwater.
perk.destinedtraits.hydrostatic_pressure: Gain armor toughness as your air depletes.
perk.destinedtraits.in_the_deep.desc: Gain increased weapon reach while you are underwater.
perk.destinedtraits.flowing_vitreum.desc: Your explosions leave behind scalding glass that damages mobs.
perk.destinedtraits.glass_them.desc: Rapid kills with this weapon create a scalding glass explosion.
perk.destinedtraits.eager_edge.desc: After switching to this weapon, attack to lunge forward.
perk.destinedtraits.surrounded.desc: This weapon deals bonus damage while surrounded by mobs.
perk.destinedtraits.dragonfly.desc: Critical hit kills with this weapon create an explosion.
perk.destinedtraits.creeping_tendrils.de: Critical hit kills grant invisibility and emit a sculk shriek from the corpse, darkening nearby mobs and clearing their targets.
perk.destinedtraits.north_star.desc: Hold use to charge a downward slam. Releasing sends a cleaving blast that damages and freezes nearby enemies. Efficiency speeds up the charge.
perk.destinedtraits.north_star.name: North Star
perk.destinedtraits.superconductor.desc: Hold a fully drawn bow for several seconds to call lightning down at the arrow's impact. The strike has a 10-second cooldown.
perk.destinedtraits.superconductor.name: Superconductor
perk.destinedtraits.clean_landing.desc: Fires an Ender Pearl instead of the center projectile. On landing, it launches nearby mobs and deals light damage. Also affects Warden of Eternities.
perk.destinedtraits.clean_landing.name: Clean Landing
perk.destinedtraits.redstone_battery.des: The battery recharges while idle, faster near powerful redstone. Attacks drain it; a fuller battery increases attack speed and critical damage. Hold use to overclock, draining it faster for greater power.
perk.destinedtraits.unwelcome.desc: Collect XP while carrying this shield, then attack while blocking to blast nearby mobs with sand, knock them back, and slow them.
perk.destinedtraits.unwelcome.name: Unwelcome
perk.destinedtraits.the_agony.desc: Taking melee damage can shock the attacker and chain to nearby enemies. Redstone power strengthens the pulse; shocking five or more enemies restores health.
perk.destinedtraits.the_agony.name: The Agony
perk.destinedtraits.fire_when_ready.desc: Greatly reduces explosion damage and restores some hunger when you survive an explosion.
perk.destinedtraits.fire_when_ready.name: Fire When Ready
perk.destinedtraits.healing_salve.desc: Once off cooldown, lethal damage converts your hunger into temporary absorption hearts over a few ticks. Death resets the cooldown.
perk.destinedtraits.healing_salve.name: Healing Salve
Time spent in combat gradually raises the chance to unleash a sand vortex that launches nearby mobs high into the air.
perk.destinedtraits.second_chance.desc: A dangerous fall or fall into the void triggers brief levitation, giving you a chance to recover midair.
perk.destinedtraits.second_chance.name: Second Chance
perk.destinedtraits.tear.desc: Critical hit kills with this weapon spread weakness to nearby mobs.
perk.destinedtraits.cauterize.desc: Regain health when you kill a mob that is on fire with this weapon.
perk.destinedtraits.killing_wind.desc: Kills with this weapon grant a brief bonus to movement speed.
perk.destinedtraits.target_lock.desc: Dealing damage to the same enemy slowly increases your damage.
perk.destinedtraits.high_ground.desc: This weapon deals increased damage to mobs below you.
perk.destinedtraits.precision_instrument: Consecutive critical hits with this weapon grant bonus damage.
perk.destinedtraits.perfect_float.desc: Being in combat for an extended period of time increases\nknockback resistance until you are out of combat.
perk.destinedtraits.frenzy.desc: Being in combat for an extended period of time increases\ndamage until you are out of combat.
perk.destinedtraits.under_over.desc: This weapon deals more damage to mobs with armor.
perk.destinedtraits.firing_line.desc: Being near other players increases the damage of this\nweapon's critical hits.
perk.destinedtraits.harmony.desc: Kills with other weapons improve this weapon’s damage\nfor a short duration.
death.attack.glass.item: %1$s was cut by glass by %2$s using %3$s
death.attack.glass.player: %1$s cut themselves on glass trying to escape %2$s
perk.destinedtraits.ensemble.desc: Being near other players increases this weapon's attack speed.

advancements.bank_those_motes.descr: Increase an item's tier at an anvil.
perk.destinedtraits.built_different.desc: Whenever this weapon loses durability, it has a chance to\nrestore health or hunger instead.
advancements.destined_traits_root.title: Destined Traits
perk.destinedtraits.forsaken_rite.desc: Arrows from this weapon create soul ritual circles on the ground\nthat buff allies and debuff mobs. Collecting XP while\ninside the circle increases its duration and radius
perk.destinedtraits.soul_of_the_ancients: This weapon launches a devastating sonic boom.
Kills with this weapon ready a brutish dash that always critically hits.
perk.destinedtraits.photosynthetic.desc: Blocking damage with this shield deals a minor amount of\ndamage and releases spores on contact.
perk.destinedtraits.better_already.desc: Collect experience to build progress toward restoring hunger.\nAdditional pieces and enhanced armor improve its effect. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.recuperation.desc: Collect experience to build progress toward restoring health.\nAdditional pieces and enhanced armor improve its effect. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.breathe_easy.desc: Collect experience to restore your air supply.\nAdditional pieces and enhanced armor improve its effect. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.argent_ordnance.desc: Collect experience to build explosive power.\nYour next explosion consumes the charge for bonus damage. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.lucent_blades.desc: Collect experience to build Lucent Blades stacks.\nMelee hits consume a stack to grant attack speed. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.reaper.desc: Gain Reaper stacks from equipped armor.\nDefeated mobs can release experience orbs while this effect is active. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.solar_runner.desc: Gain movement speed while you are burning.\nEnhanced armor increases the speed bonus. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.backdraft.desc: Gain armor toughness while burning enemies are nearby.\nEnhanced armor increases the toughness bonus. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.perpetual_motion.des: Moving with this weapon builds handling and stability bonuses.\nKeep moving to strengthen them and slowly repair the weapon. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.envious_arsenal.desc: Kills with another weapon restore this weapon's durability.\nEnhanced perks restore more durability. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.rising_deep.desc: Gain increased attack reach while underwater.\nEnhanced perks grant an even greater reach bonus. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.repulsor_brace.desc: Defeating an enemy with active effects grants absorption.\nEnhanced perks strengthen the protection. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.explosive_head.desc: Arrows fired from this weapon explode on impact. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.bait_and_switch.desc: Damage enemies with three different weapons in quick succession,\nincluding this one, to gain a temporary damage bonus. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.one_for_all.desc: Damage three different enemies in quick succession to gain\na temporary damage bonus. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.the_old_wounds.desc: Damage enemies to record their active effects, then spend\nexperience to brew a potion containing those effects. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.soulfire_eminence.de: Eating food summons a soul wisp that attacks nearby hostiles.\nMore nourishing food sustains the wisp for longer. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.nowhere_fast.desc: Thrown tridents rise before plunging toward their target.\nGreater falls deal more impact damage and splash nearby foes. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.tidal_pulse.desc: Sprint to charge, then crouch to surge forward and displace\nnearby mobs and items. (AI)
perk.destinedtraits.ender_artillery.desc: Build a charge by damaging enemies, then unleash homing\nShulker bullets with further hits. (AI)
